description: Machine-readable source of truth for EngineOS model-tier assignment. rules/models.md's assignment table is checked against this file by scripts/validate-engineos.sh (C16): tier/model pairs must agree, escalation order must be internally consistent, and every work type must resolve to a defined tier.

work_types.title: Spec, PRD, requirements, problem framing, brainstorming
Architecture, design, task decomposition, contract/interface design, fan-out planning
Standards/spec code review against an existing diff
Writing code, tests, migrations, config — against an existing spec/design
Renames, boilerplate, file moves, formatting, simple lookups, summaries

degradation_ladder.take_when: The same input was already computed and inputs are unchanged.
degradation_ladder.not_when: The upstream changed, or freshness is part of the requirement.

degradation_ladder.take_when: The dropped layers are rules/context.md layers 5-6.
degradation_ladder.not_when: It would drop layer 1-2, or the evidence the answer rests on.

degradation_ladder.take_when: Work is mechanical with a fully specified target.
degradation_ladder.not_when: Gates assume the stronger tier, or risk is medium+ per rules/risk-autonomy.md.

degradation_ladder.take_when: The result is not needed to unblock anything now.
degradation_ladder.not_when: Something is blocked on it, or deferral hides a failure.

degradation_ladder.take_when: Every rung above failed its check.
